# Load packages

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)

library(Biobase)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(harmony)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)

library(NMF)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(CellChat)
library(pheatmap)
library(nichenetr)
```



# Load data

```{r, include=FALSE}
load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/muscle_integrated.RData")
```


## Define CTLs and Tumour-bearing

```{r, include=FALSE}
ctl_samples <- c(
  "Agca_snLLC_CTL",
  "Brown_scLLC_CTL",
  "Kim_scB16F10_CTL",
  "Pryce_scC26_CTL",
  "Pryce_scKPP_CTL",
  "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"
)

early_tb_samples <- c(
  "Brown_scLLC_2w",
  "Brown_scLLC_2.5w"
)

endpoint_tb_samples <- c(
  "Agca_snLLC_LLC",
  "Brown_scLLC_3.5w",
  "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10",
  "Pryce_scC26_C26",
  "Pryce_scKPP_KPP",
  "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"
)



sc_combined$condition <- NA

sc_combined$condition[sc_combined$orig.ident %in% ctl_samples] <- "Control"

sc_combined$condition[sc_combined$orig.ident %in% early_tb_samples] <- "Early tumour-bearing"

sc_combined$condition[sc_combined$orig.ident %in% endpoint_tb_samples] <- "Endpoint tumour-bearing"

rm(ctl_samples, early_tb_samples, endpoint_tb_samples)
```



# Subset Monocytes, Macrophages, Neutrophils, NK cells

### NOTE - The reason why we chose these immune cells specifically is because they have the greatest increase in communication within the muscle with cachexia

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(sc_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

monocytes_integrated <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Monocytes")
macrophages_integrated <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Macrophages")
neutrophils_integrated <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Neutrophils")
nk_cells_integrated <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "NK cells")
```



# Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(Agca_snLLC_CTL, Agca_snLLC_LLC, Brown_scLLC_CTL, Brown_scLLC_2w, Brown_scLLC_2.5w, Brown_scLLC_3.5w, Kim_scB16F10_CTL, Kim_scB16F10_B16F10, Pryce_scC26_CTL, Pryce_scC26_C26, Pryce_scKPP_CTL, Pryce_scKPP_KPP, Zhang_snKIC_CTL, Zhang_snKIC_KIC, DEGs_sc_combined, all_genes)
```



# Plot UMAP 

## Highlighting cells

```{r}
Idents(sc_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

sc_combined$highlight_cells <- "Other"

sc_combined$highlight_cells[sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "Monocytes"] <- "Monocytes"
sc_combined$highlight_cells[sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "Macrophages"] <- "Macrophages"
sc_combined$highlight_cells[sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "Neutrophils"] <- "Neutrophils"
sc_combined$highlight_cells[sc_combined$seurat_clusters == "NK cells"] <- "NK cells"

DimPlot(
  sc_combined,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "highlight_cells",
  cols = c(
    "Other" = "grey85",
    "Monocytes" = "#80E5FF",
    "Macrophages" = "#1E90FF",
    "Neutrophils" = "#4169E1",
    "NK cells" = "#5B0E8A"
  ),
  pt.size = 1, raster = FALSE
) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = NULL, x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
rm(sc_combined)
```

# Plot stacked barplot for subcluster proportions

## For each condition
```{r, include=FALSE}

  dplyr::select(orig.ident, subcluster) %>%
  group_by(orig.ident, subcluster) %>%
  summarize(count = n()) %>%
  group_by(orig.ident) %>%
  mutate(percentage = count / sum(count) * 100)

  dplyr::select(orig.ident, subcluster) %>%
  group_by(orig.ident, subcluster) %>%

# GO terms for tumour-bearing Monocytes, Macrophages, Neutrophils, NK cells

## Get DEGs in tumour-bearing cells

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(monocytes_integrated) <- "orig.ident"
Idents(macrophages_integrated) <- "orig.ident"
Idents(neutrophils_integrated) <- "orig.ident"
Idents(nk_cells_integrated) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_cachectic_monocytes_integrated <- FindMarkers(monocytes_integrated, ident.1 = c("Agca_snLLC_LLC", "Brown_scLLC_3.5w", "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10", "Pryce_scC26_C26", "Pryce_scKPP_KPP", "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"), ident.2 = c("Agca_snLLC_CTL", "Brown_scLLC_CTL", "Kim_scB16F10_CTL", "Pryce_scC26_CTL", "Pryce_scKPP_CTL", "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)

DEGs_cachectic_macrophages_integrated <- FindMarkers(macrophages_integrated, ident.1 = c("Agca_snLLC_LLC", "Brown_scLLC_3.5w", "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10", "Pryce_scC26_C26", "Pryce_scKPP_KPP", "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"), ident.2 = c("Agca_snLLC_CTL", "Brown_scLLC_CTL", "Kim_scB16F10_CTL", "Pryce_scC26_CTL", "Pryce_scKPP_CTL", "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)

### NOTE - did not include Zhang_snKIC_CTL because it does not have any neutrophils
DEGs_cachectic_neutrophils_integrated <- FindMarkers(neutrophils_integrated, ident.1 = c("Agca_snLLC_LLC", "Brown_scLLC_3.5w", "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10", "Pryce_scC26_C26", "Pryce_scKPP_KPP", "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"), ident.2 = c("Agca_snLLC_CTL", "Brown_scLLC_CTL", "Kim_scB16F10_CTL", "Pryce_scC26_CTL", "Pryce_scKPP_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)

### NOTE - did not include Agca_snLLC_CTL because it does not have any NK cells
DEGs_cachectic_nk_cells_integrated <- FindMarkers(nk_cells_integrated, ident.1 = c("Agca_snLLC_LLC", "Brown_scLLC_3.5w", "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10", "Pryce_scC26_C26", "Pryce_scKPP_KPP", "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"), ident.2 = c("Brown_scLLC_CTL", "Kim_scB16F10_CTL", "Pryce_scC26_CTL", "Pryce_scKPP_CTL", "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```


## Subset DEG for p_val_adj < 0.05

```{r, include=FALSE}
DEGs_cachectic_monocytes_integrated <- na.omit(DEGs_cachectic_monocytes_integrated)

DEGs_cachectic_macrophages_integrated <- na.omit(DEGs_cachectic_macrophages_integrated)

DEGs_cachectic_neutrophils_integrated <- na.omit(DEGs_cachectic_neutrophils_integrated)

DEGs_cachectic_nk_cells_integrated <- na.omit(DEGs_cachectic_nk_cells_integrated)



DEGs_cachectic_monocytes_integrated <- subset(DEGs_cachectic_monocytes_integrated, p_val_adj < 0.05)

DEGs_cachectic_macrophages_integrated <- subset(DEGs_cachectic_macrophages_integrated, p_val_adj < 0.05)

DEGs_cachectic_neutrophils_integrated <- subset(DEGs_cachectic_neutrophils_integrated, p_val_adj < 0.05)

DEGs_cachectic_nk_cells_integrated <- subset(DEGs_cachectic_nk_cells_integrated, p_val_adj < 0.05)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.csv(DEGs_cachectic_monocytes_integrated, file = "DEGs_cachectic_monocytes_integrated.csv")

write.csv(DEGs_cachectic_macrophages_integrated, file = "DEGs_cachectic_macrophages_integrated.csv")

write.csv(DEGs_cachectic_neutrophils_integrated, file = "DEGs_cachectic_neutrophils_integrated.csv")

write.csv(DEGs_cachectic_nk_cells_integrated, file = "DEGs_cachectic_nk_cells_integrated.csv")
```

# Confirm TGFb1 signaling in Monocyte, Macrophages, NK cells by looking at expression of downstream signaling

## Find markers 

```{r}
# From msigdbr HALLMARK_TGF_BETA_SIGNALING
tgfb1_gene_list <- c("Nog", "Cdkn1c", "Fnta", "Skil", "Xiap", "Ifngr2", "Hdac1", "Slc20a1", "Smad1", "Bmpr2", "Rhoa", "Smad7", "Klf10", "Tgif1", "Smad3", "Hipk2", "Cdk9", "Smad6", "Ncor2", "Bmpr1a", "Map3k7", "Bcar3", "Ube2d3", "Rab31", "Wwtr1", "Smurf1", "Ppp1r15a", "Pmepa1", "Trim33", "Arid4b", "Acvr1", "Apc", "Bmp2", "Ctnnb1", "Cdh1", "Eng", "Fkbp1a", "Id1", "Id2", "Id3", "Junb", "Furin", "Serpine1", "Ski", "Sptbn1", "Tgfb1", "Tgfbr1", "Thbs1", "Tjp1", "Ltbp2", "Ppm1a")

# FindMarkers
Idents(monocytes_integrated) <- "condition"
Idents(macrophages_integrated) <- "condition"

tgfb1_early_genes_mono <- FindMarkers(
  monocytes_integrated,
  ident.1 = "Early tumour-bearing",
  ident.2 = "Control",
  features = tgfb1_gene_list,
  min.pct = 0
)

tgfb1_early_genes_macro <- FindMarkers(
  macrophages_integrated,
  ident.1 = "Early tumour-bearing",
  ident.2 = "Control",
  features = tgfb1_gene_list,
  min.pct = 0
)

tgfb1_end_genes_mono <- FindMarkers(
  monocytes_integrated,
  ident.1 = "Endpoint tumour-bearing",
  ident.2 = "Control",
  features = tgfb1_gene_list,
  min.pct = 0
)

tgfb1_end_genes_macro <- FindMarkers(
  macrophages_integrated,
  ident.1 = "Endpoint tumour-bearing",
  ident.2 = "Control",
  features = tgfb1_gene_list,
  min.pct = 0
)

# Merge with gene list and keep gene column
tgfb1_early_genes_mono <- tgfb1_gene_list %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames("gene") %>%
  left_join(
    tgfb1_early_genes_mono %>% rownames_to_column("gene"),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  # Replace NAs with 0
  mutate(across(c(avg_log2FC, p_val, p_val_adj), ~replace_na(., 0)))

tgfb1_early_genes_macro <- tgfb1_gene_list %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames("gene") %>%
  left_join(
    tgfb1_early_genes_macro %>% rownames_to_column("gene"),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  # Replace NAs with 0
  mutate(across(c(avg_log2FC, p_val, p_val_adj), ~replace_na(., 0)))



tgfb1_end_genes_mono <- tgfb1_gene_list %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames("gene") %>%
  left_join(
    tgfb1_end_genes_mono %>% rownames_to_column("gene"),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(avg_log2FC, p_val, p_val_adj), ~replace_na(., 0)))

tgfb1_end_genes_macro <- tgfb1_gene_list %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames("gene") %>%
  left_join(
    tgfb1_end_genes_macro %>% rownames_to_column("gene"),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(avg_log2FC, p_val, p_val_adj), ~replace_na(., 0)))

tgfb1_early_genes_mono
tgfb1_early_genes_macro

tgfb1_end_genes_mono
tgfb1_end_genes_macro
```

```{r}
# Prepare data
tgfb1_early_genes_mono <- tgfb1_early_genes_mono %>%
  mutate(
    cell_type = "Monocytes",

tgfb1_early_genes_macro <- tgfb1_early_genes_macro %>%
  mutate(
    cell_type = "Macrophages",
    avg_log2FC_plot = ifelse(p_val_adj > 0.05, 0, avg_log2FC),
    p_fill = ifelse(p_val_adj > 0.05, NA, p_val_adj)
  )

tgfb1_end_genes_mono <- tgfb1_end_genes_mono %>%
  mutate(
    cell_type = "Monocytes",
    avg_log2FC_plot = ifelse(p_val_adj > 0.05, 0, avg_log2FC),
    p_fill = ifelse(p_val_adj > 0.05, NA, p_val_adj)
  )

tgfb1_end_genes_macro <- tgfb1_end_genes_macro %>%
  mutate(
    cell_type = "Macrophages",
    avg_log2FC_plot = ifelse(p_val_adj > 0.05, 0, avg_log2FC),
    p_fill = ifelse(p_val_adj > 0.05, NA, p_val_adj)
  )


# Combine Early data
tgfb1_early_combined <- bind_rows(
  tgfb1_early_genes_mono,
  tgfb1_early_genes_macro
) %>%
  mutate(
    cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = c("Monocytes", "Macrophages"))
  )


# Combine Endpoint data
tgfb1_end_combined <- bind_rows(
  tgfb1_end_genes_mono,
  tgfb1_end_genes_macro
) %>%
  mutate(
    cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = c("Monocytes", "Macrophages"))
  )


# Plot Early
ggplot(
  tgfb1_early_combined,
  aes(
    x = gene,
    y = avg_log2FC_plot,
    fill = p_fill,
    colour = cell_type,
    group = cell_type
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Monocytes" = "#80E5FF",
      "Macrophages" = "#1E90FF"
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "blue",
    high = "red",
    na.value = "black",
    limits = c(1e-40, 0.05),
    oob = scales::squish,
    trans = scales::log10_trans(),
    name = "Adjusted p-value"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-3, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "TGFb1 signaling (Early tumour-bearing)",
    x = "",
    y = "avg_log2FC (significant genes only)",
    colour = "Cell type"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )


# Plot Endpoint
ggplot(
  tgfb1_end_combined,
  aes(
    x = gene,
    y = avg_log2FC_plot,
    fill = p_fill,
    colour = cell_type,
    group = cell_type
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Monocytes" = "#80E5FF",
      "Macrophages" = "#1E90FF"
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "blue",
    high = "red",
    na.value = "black",
    limits = c(1e-40, 0.05),
    oob = scales::squish,
    trans = scales::log10_trans(),
    name = "Adjusted p-value"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-3, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "TGFb1 signaling (Endpoint tumour-bearing)",
    x = "",
    y = "avg_log2FC (significant genes only)",
    colour = "Cell type"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Heatmap to show tumour communication to monocytes, macrophages, neutrophils, NK cells

```{r}
tumour_to_immune_counts_mat <- cellchat_tb_secreted@net$count[
  c("Tumour Malignant cells", "Tumour Endothelial cells", "Tumour Cancer-associated fibroblasts", "Tumour Monocytes/macrophages", "Tumour Neutrophils", "Tumour B cells", "Tumour T cells", "Tumour NK cells"),
  c("Muscle Platelets", "Muscle Mast cells", "Muscle Dendritic cells", "Muscle Monocytes", "Muscle Macrophages", "Muscle Neutrophils", "Muscle B cells", "Muscle T cells", "Muscle NK cells")]

pheatmap(
  tumour_to_immune_counts_mat,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(35),
  breaks = seq(0, 35, length.out = 36),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  fontsize = 8,
  angle_col = 45,
  cellwidth = 10,
  cellheight = 10
  )
```



# Heatmap of change in monocytes, macrophages, neutrophils, NK cells communication within the muscle

```{r}
ctl_muscle_immune_counts_mat <- cellchat_ctl_all@net$count[
  c("Muscle Platelets", "Muscle Mast cells", "Muscle Dendritic cells", "Muscle Monocytes", "Muscle Macrophages", "Muscle Neutrophils", "Muscle B cells", "Muscle T cells", "Muscle NK cells"),
  c("Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei", "Muscle Endothelial cells", "Muscle vSMCs", "Muscle Pericytes", "Muscle FAPs", "Muscle Tenocytes", "Muscle Platelets", "Muscle Mast cells", "Muscle Dendritic cells", "Muscle Monocytes", "Muscle Macrophages", "Muscle Neutrophils", "Muscle B cells", "Muscle T cells", "Muscle NK cells", "Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells")]

tb_muscle_immune_counts_mat <- cellchat_tb_all@net$count[
  c("Muscle Platelets", "Muscle Mast cells", "Muscle Dendritic cells", "Muscle Monocytes", "Muscle Macrophages", "Muscle Neutrophils", "Muscle B cells", "Muscle T cells", "Muscle NK cells"),
  c("Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei", "Muscle Endothelial cells", "Muscle vSMCs", "Muscle Pericytes", "Muscle FAPs", "Muscle Tenocytes", "Muscle Platelets", "Muscle Mast cells", "Muscle Dendritic cells", "Muscle Monocytes", "Muscle Macrophages", "Muscle Neutrophils", "Muscle B cells", "Muscle T cells", "Muscle NK cells", "Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells")]

diff_counts_mat <- tb_muscle_immune_counts_mat - ctl_muscle_immune_counts_mat

n_neg <- 40   # -40 → 0
n_pos <- 40   # 0 → 40

# Create two color gradients
neg_colours <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white"))(n_neg)
pos_colours <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(n_pos)
colours <- c(neg_colours, pos_colours)

# Define breaks to match colors
breaks <- seq(-40, 40, length.out = length(colours) + 1)

# Plot
pheatmap(
  diff_counts_mat,
  color = colours,
  breaks = breaks,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  fontsize = 8,
  angle_col = 45,
  cellwidth = 10,
  cellheight = 10
)
```

```

  netP_LLC_end_all$target %in% c("Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei", "Muscle Endothelial cells", "Muscle vSMCs", "Muscle Pericytes", "Muscle FAPs", "Muscle Tenocytes", "Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells"), 
]

### Get unique pathways from specified cells to target cells
unique(netP_LLC_end_all$pathway_name)
```

### KPP_KIC

```{r}
### Extract communication probabilities at the pathway level
netP_KPP_KIC_end_all <- subsetCommunication(cellchat_KPP_KIC_end_all, slot.name = "netP")

### Subset for enriched pathways for target cells to source cells
netP_KPP_KIC_end_all <- netP_KPP_KIC_end_all[

]

unique(netP_KPP_KIC_end_all$pathway_name)

"THBS", "GALECTIN", "ADGRG", "OSM" are up in all 4 conditions plus B16, LLC, KPC tumour-bearing but NOT CTL.

# Relative information flow of enriched macrophage signaling pathways

## Load integrated muscle data (muscle+tumours won't work)

```{r, include=FALSE}
load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/cellchat/integrated_cellchat_muscle.RData")

rm(cellchat_ctl_all_Agca, cellchat_ctl_all_B16F10, cellchat_ctl_all_LLC, cellchat_end_secreted, cellchat_end_ecm, cellchat_end_nps, cellchat_end_ccc)
```

## Merge cellchat objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
object.list <- list("CTL" = cellchat_ctl_all, "Tumour-bearing" = cellchat_end_all)

names(object.list)

cellchat_merged_all <- mergeCellChat(object.list, add.names = names(object.list))
```


## Information flow of enriched pathways

### NOTE - Pathways highlighted BLUE are significantly higher in CTL, RED in TUMOUR-BEARING, BLACK are equal.

```{r}
rankNet(cellchat_merged_all, mode = "comparison", stacked = TRUE, do.stat = TRUE, sources.use = "Monocytes", color.use = c("CTL" = "blue", "Tumour-bearing" = "red"))

rankNet(cellchat_merged_all, mode = "comparison", stacked = TRUE, do.stat = TRUE, sources.use = "Macrophages", color.use = c("CTL" = "blue", "Tumour-bearing" = "red"))

rankNet(cellchat_merged_all, mode = "comparison", stacked = TRUE, do.stat = TRUE, sources.use = "Neutrophils", color.use = c("CTL" = "blue", "Tumour-bearing" = "red"))

rankNet(cellchat_merged_all, mode = "comparison", stacked = TRUE, do.stat = TRUE, sources.use = "NK cells", color.use = c("CTL" = "blue", "Tumour-bearing" = "red"))

rankNet(cellchat_merged_all, mode = "comparison", stacked = TRUE, do.stat = TRUE, sources.use = c("Monocytes", "Macrophages",
    "Neutrophils", "NK cells"), color.use = c("CTL" = "blue", "Tumour-bearing" = "red"))
```
